svg.title: Repeated quantization bias and dither uncertainty are different objects
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Repeated quantization bias and dither uncertainty are different objects
Ideal codes near zero, away from overload
Same 64-sample waveform repeated: actual deterministic bias does not average away
No dither / no noise: a 10 μV peak tone returns all zeros in either 2 V-span quantizer.
Dither preserves conditional mean only under the specified injection / independence / range model.
Bias curves and stochastic bounds are separate criteria, not measured converter performance.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
